children.cn: 引出朋友与玛丽的能力及社团推荐

children.text: I have two good friends, Mary and Peter.
children.cn: 我有两个好朋友，玛丽和彼得。
children.notes: two good friends = 两个好朋友
children.statement: 开门见山引出文章要介绍的两位主人公。
children.explanation: 明确交代了表格中的人物。

children.text: Mary can play the drums and sing sweet songs very well.
children.cn: 玛丽能把架子鼓打得很好，歌也唱得很动听。
children.notes: play the drums = 打鼓；very well = 很好（副词修饰动词）
children.statement: “very well” 是副词短语，修饰 play 和 sing。
children.explanation: 符合表格中 Mary 的 “✔ drums, sing” 要点。
children.keywords: play drums, sing sweet songs, well

children.text: However, she cannot play Chinese chess at all.
children.cn: 然而，她一点也不会下中国象棋。
children.notes: not... at all = 一点也不；play Chinese chess = 下中国象棋
children.statement: “However” 表转折，符合表格中 “✘ Chinese chess”。
children.explanation: 准确对应 Mary 不能做的事情。

children.text: So I think she should join the music club to show her musical talent.
children.cn: 所以我觉得她应该加入音乐俱乐部来展现她的音乐才华。
children.notes: should = 应该（情态动词）；musical talent = 音乐才能
children.statement: “to show her musical talent” 动词不定式作目的状语。
children.explanation: 针对 Mary 的特长给出合情合理的俱乐部建议。

children.cn: 彼得的能力与社团推荐及总结

children.text: As for Peter, he can play soccer and volleyball skillfully.
children.cn: 至于彼得，他能熟练地踢足球和打排球。
children.notes: As for = 至于；skillfully = 熟练地（副词）
children.explanation: 准确对应表格中 Peter “✔ soccer, volleyball” 的要点。
children.keywords: As for Peter, play soccer, volleyball

children.text: But he cannot play basketball well.
children.statement: “But” 对应表格中 “✘ basketball” 的要点。
children.explanation: 准确表达 Peter 不擅长打篮球。

children.text: I advise him to join the basketball club so that he can practice and improve.
children.cn: 我建议他加入篮球俱乐部，以便他能训练并提高技能。
children.notes: advise sb. to do sth. = 建议某人做某事；so that = 以便（引导目的状语从句）
children.statement: “so that” 引导目的状语从句。
children.explanation: 提出了针对性的建议及提升目标。
children.keywords: advise him, join basketball club, practice, improve

children.text: I believe they will both have great fun in these clubs.
children.cn: 我相信他们俩都会在这些社团里玩得很开心。
children.notes: have great fun = 玩得开心；in these clubs = 在这些俱乐部里
children.statement: 文末表达美好祝愿，使文章结构完整。
children.explanation: 总结全文，升华友谊主题。

children.cn: 引出朋友与玛丽的能力及社团推荐

children.text: Among all my classmates, Mary and Peter are two of my most cherished friends.
children.cn: 在我所有的同学中，玛丽和彼得是我最珍视的两位朋友。
children.notes: cherished = 珍视的，宝贵的；two of my... = 我……中的两个
children.statement: 高级定语修饰语增强了情感色彩。
children.explanation: 比简单的 good friends 更有文采。

children.text: Mary has an amazing gift for music, being able to beat the drums energetically and sing melodious tunes.
children.cn: 玛丽在音乐方面极具天赋，能够充满活力地打架子鼓并唱出悦耳动听的曲调。
children.notes: have a gift for = 在……有天赋；melodious tunes = 悦耳的曲调
children.statement: “being able to...” 为现在分词短语作补充说明状语。
children.explanation: 丰富了对 Mary 音乐能力的描绘。
children.keywords: gift for music, beat drums, melodious tunes

children.text: Nevertheless, playing Chinese chess remains a complete mystery to her.
children.cn: 然而，下中国象棋对她而言仍然是一窍不通。
children.notes: Nevertheless = 然而（高级转折词）；remains a complete mystery = 仍然完全是个谜/难以理解
children.explanation: 形象生动地对应 “✘ Chinese chess”。

children.text: Therefore, I strongly recommend that she join the music club, where she can shine on stage and build more confidence.
children.cn: 因此，我强烈建议她加入音乐俱乐部，在那里她可以在舞台上大放异彩并建立更多的自信。
children.notes: recommend that sb. (should) do = 建议某人做某事（虚拟语气）；where 引导定语从句
children.statement: “where” 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 music club。
children.explanation: 虚拟语气加定语从句展现多重高阶句法。
children.keywords: strongly recommend, join music club, shine on stage, confidence

children.cn: 彼得的能力与社团推荐及总结

children.text: On the other hand, Peter is a born athlete who excels in soccer and volleyball with remarkable agility.
children.cn: 另一方面，彼得是个天生的运动员，凭借出色的敏捷性在足球和排球项目中表现优异。
children.notes: On the other hand = 另一方面；excel in = 在……擅长/出众；agility = 敏捷度
children.statement: “who excels in...” 为定语从句修饰 athlete。
children.explanation: 生动刻画了 Peter 出色的体育运动能力。
children.keywords: On the other hand, born athlete, excels in soccer, volleyball

children.text: Surprisingly, basketball is currently his weak spot because he struggles with dribbling and shooting.
children.cn: 令人意外的是，篮球目前是他的弱项，因为他在运球和投篮方面还比较吃力。
children.notes: weak spot = 弱项，薄弱环节；struggle with = 在……方面感到吃力
children.statement: “because” 引导原因状语从句阐释篮球打不好的原因。
children.explanation: 合理补充细节支撑 “✘ basketball”。
children.keywords: weak spot, struggles with dribbling, shooting

children.text: By joining the basketball club, he will undoubtedly master teamwork and sharpen his athletic skills rapidly.
children.cn: 通过加入篮球俱乐部，他无疑将掌握团队合作并迅速提升他的运动技能。
children.notes: By joining... = 通过加入（介词短语作方式状语）；sharpen skills = 提升技能
children.statement: “By doing sth.” 介词短语在句首作状语。
children.explanation: 全面展望了加入俱乐部带来的成长与蜕变。
children.keywords: By joining, basketball club, teamwork, sharpen skills
